snippet.title: DICTOCRACY ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough.

Will you lead Adelphia to glory and get re-elected or will you fail as many others before you ? Your destiny lies in your hands !

WISHLIST TODAY -  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310870/DICTOCRACY/
